title: Session
description: <root>/<session id>.json; the file name without .json is the session id. A session is a working context: a cwd, the part of the catalogs it may use, and the active profile. It holds no model, tool or MCP definitions.

name.description: Display name of the session, shown beside its id. Defaults to the session id.

cwd.description: Working directory of every run in this session. Absolute path (or ~). Beats settings.cwd of this file and the root defaults; a profile's settings.cwd beats it.

category.description: Optional folder name used to group sessions in listings. It does not change the session id.

scope.description: What this session may use. Only profiles are scoped: models, toolsets and MCP servers are always all available, and a profile narrows models itself.

profiles.description: Narrows the profiles. Items: "<category>" for a whole folder, "<category>/<name>" for one file, or "*". A missing key offers every profile; [] offers none. An item that matches no profile is a load error.

active_profile.description: Profile used when a request names none, written <category>/<name>, for example "dev/coder". Must be inside scope.profiles.

settings.description: Overrides of the setting keys listed in propertyNames. Objects merge key by key with the level above; arrays and scalars replace it. Each value follows the same key in setting.schema.json.
